summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan across four dependency waves. Adopts remedy (a) at conclusion-stage.md Step 4b (the one dispatcher of three that omits target_root, re-confirmed live), a revised remedy (b) that strengthens meta-builder-agent.md's already-present GLOBAL_ROOT fallback into a loud status:blocked refusal rather than adding a resolution step it already has, a skill-meta discharge, and remedy (c) as a standing siting rule kept distinct from the specs/** exemption. Also settles the deploy-path file_scope convention in the schema reference. Validator passes clean in both default and --strict mode; file_scope harvests to seven real paths plus __WHOLE_TREE__.
